investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Rivershore Goods (online retail); Platform: AWS sa-east-1 (zones sa-east-1a/sa-east-1b/sa-east-1c); network range 10.217.0.0/16; Object storage: provider-managed bucket/account for user content, accessed directly by backend services; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
